<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Protection — SurakshaOne</title>
<meta name="description" content="Five protections in one membership — Wellness, CyberSafe, TravelShield, LifeSecure, and ParentCare.">
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/png;base64," type="image/png">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --ink:#111826; --ink-2:#1a2744; --ink-soft:#666c78; --mute:#8b919c;
    --teal-deep:#2c5fdd; --teal:#00b0d6; --purple:#3738ac; --coral:#e7000b; --blue:#2c5fdd;
    --brand-blue:#2c5fdd; --brand-blue-deep:#3738ac; --brand-cyan:#00b0d6; --brand-green:#24c27d;
    --paper:#ffffff; --paper-2:#f2f5fb; --white:#fff;
    --line:#e5e8ed; --line-2:rgba(17,24,38,.08);
    --sh-sm:0 1px 2px rgba(44,95,221,.06);
    --sh:0 8px 28px rgba(44,95,221,.10);
    --sh-lg:0 24px 60px rgba(44,95,221,.14);
    --r:20px; --maxw:1180px;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}*{animation-duration:.01ms!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}}
  body{margin:0;font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--paper);line-height:1.55;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
  h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;margin:0;line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-weight:700}
  a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
  img{max-width:100%;display:block}
  button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer}
  .wrap{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px}
  section{padding:92px 0}
  @media (max-width:720px){section{padding:60px 0}}
  .sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0)}
  a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible{outline:2.5px solid var(--teal);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:4px}

  .eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal-deep);font-weight:500;margin-bottom:18px}
  .eyebrow::before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--brand-blue),var(--brand-cyan))}
  .sec-head{max-width:660px;margin-bottom:50px}
  .sec-head h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.6vw,40px);font-weight:600}
  .sec-head p{margin-top:14px;font-size:16.5px;color:var(--ink-soft)}
  .center{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;text-align:center}

  .btn{display:inline-block;padding:14px 26px;border-radius:100px;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;border:1px solid transparent;transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s,background .15s}
  .btn-p{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--brand-blue-deep),var(--brand-blue) 55%,var(--brand-cyan));color:#fff;border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(44,95,221,.28)}
  .btn-p:hover{box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(44,95,221,.34);transform:translateY(-2px)}
  .btn-g{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border:1.5px solid var(--line)}
  .btn-g:hover{border-color:var(--ink);background:var(--paper-2)}

  /* NAV */
  header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(255,255,255,.86);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .navbar{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding:13px 28px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
  .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
  .brand img{height:34px;width:auto}
  .brand-name{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:700;font-size:19px}
  .brand-name b{color:var(--teal-deep)}
  .nav-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:30px;margin-left:auto}
  .nav-links > a,.has-dd > a{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink-soft)}
  .nav-links > a:hover,.has-dd > a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
  .nav-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;margin-left:28px}
  .nav-cta{padding:10px 20px;border-radius:100px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--brand-blue-deep),var(--brand-blue) 55%,var(--brand-cyan));color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(44,95,221,.28)}
  .nav-cta:hover{box-shadow:var(--sh)}
  .nav-toggle{display:none;background:none;border:none;padding:6px}
  .nav-toggle span{display:block;width:22px;height:2px;background:var(--ink);margin:5px 0;border-radius:2px}
  .has-dd{position:relative}
  .dd{position:absolute;top:100%;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(6px);background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:8px;width:290px;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:.15s}
  .has-dd:hover .dd,.has-dd:focus-within .dd{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(2px)}
  .dd a{display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px;border-radius:9px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
  .dd a:hover{background:var(--paper-2)}
  .dd a i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:6px}
  .dd a em{display:block;font-style:normal;font-weight:400;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:1px}
  @media (max-width:960px){
    .nav-links{position:fixed;inset:60px 0 auto 0;background:#fff;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:0;padding:8px 28px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);transform:translateY(-150%);transition:transform .25s;box-shadow:var(--sh);max-height:calc(100vh - 60px);overflow-y:auto;margin-left:0}
    .nav-links.open{transform:translateY(0)}
    .nav-links > a,.has-dd{width:100%;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2)}
    .nav-links > a{padding:13px 0}
    .has-dd > a{display:block;padding:13px 0}
    .dd{position:static;opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:none;box-shadow:none;border:none;width:100%;display:none;padding:0 0 8px 10px;left:auto}
    .dd a{padding:9px 8px}
    .has-dd:hover .dd,.has-dd:focus-within .dd{transform:none;position:static}
    .has-dd.open .dd{display:block}
    .nav-toggle{display:block}
    .nav-cta{display:none}
  }
  @media (max-width:400px){.brand-name{font-size:16.5px}}

  /* HERO */
  .hero{padding:80px 0 56px}
  .hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:52px;align-items:center}
  @media (max-width:960px){.hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:48px}}
  .hero h1{font-size:clamp(36px,5vw,58px);font-weight:600}
  .hero h1 em{font-style:normal;background:linear-gradient(100deg,var(--brand-blue-deep),var(--brand-blue) 45%,var(--brand-cyan));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
  .hero .sub{margin-top:22px;font-size:18px;color:var(--ink-soft);max-width:500px}
  .hero-ctas{display:flex;gap:13px;margin-top:32px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .hero-fine{margin-top:16px;font-size:13px;color:var(--mute)}
  .orbit{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:1/1;max-width:450px;margin:0 auto}
  .ring{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px dashed var(--line)}
  .ring.r2{inset:40px;border-style:dotted}
  .core{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:33%;height:33%;border-radius:32%;background:linear-gradient(155deg,var(--brand-blue-deep),var(--brand-blue) 55%,var(--brand-cyan));display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 20px 46px rgba(44,95,221,.28)}
  .core svg{width:52%;height:52%}
  .onode{position:absolute;width:17%;height:17%;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:var(--sh-sm);animation:fl 6s ease-in-out infinite}
  .onode svg{width:46%;height:46%}
  @keyframes fl{0%,100%{margin-top:0}50%{margin-top:-7px}}
  .olabel{position:absolute;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-soft);background:#fff;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:100px;border:1px solid var(--line-2);white-space:nowrap}
  @media (max-width:960px){.orbit{max-width:330px}.olabel{display:none}}

  /* STRIPE */
  .stripe{background:var(--brand-blue-deep);color:#fff;padding:38px 0}
  .stripe .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:26px}
  .stripe .it{flex:1 1 210px}
  .stripe .k{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:600;font-size:23px}
  .stripe .d{font-size:12.8px;color:#B9C3D6;margin-top:5px;line-height:1.5}
  .stripe .src{display:block;margin-top:4px;font-size:11px;color:#7C8FAB}

  /* WHY */
  .why-band{background:var(--paper-2);border-top:1px solid var(--line-2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2)}
  .g4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px}
  @media (max-width:900px){.g4{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
  @media (max-width:520px){.g4{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
  .wcard{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:24px 20px}
  .wcard .n{font-family:'Inter';font-size:12px;color:var(--teal-deep);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:12px;display:block}
  .wcard h4{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px}
  .wcard p{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0}

  /* MODULES */
  .mods{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}
  @media (max-width:980px){.mods{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
  @media (max-width:620px){.mods{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
  .mcard{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:26px 22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:transform .18s,box-shadow .18s}
  .mcard:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
  .mic{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:18px}
  .mic svg{width:22px;height:22px;stroke-width:1.8;fill:none}
  .mcard h3{font-size:19px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:7px}
  .mcard .tag{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:16px}
  .mcard ul{list-style:none;margin:0 0 20px;padding:0;flex:1}
  .mcard li{font-size:13.8px;color:var(--ink-soft);padding:6px 0 6px 19px;position:relative}
  .mcard li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:14px;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal)}
  .mfoot{padding-top:15px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-2);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600}
  .i-well{background:#eaf0ff}.i-well svg{stroke:var(--teal-deep)}
  .i-cyber{background:#E7ECFB}.i-cyber svg{stroke:var(--blue)}
  .i-travel{background:#FCEEE9}.i-travel svg{stroke:var(--coral)}
  .i-life{background:#EFE7F7}.i-life svg{stroke:var(--purple)}
  .i-parent{background:#FDF0E3}.i-parent svg{stroke:#B87333}

  /* DEEP DIVE */
  .dd-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:60px;align-items:center;padding:74px 0}
  .dd-row:not(:last-child){border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2)}
  .dd-row.rev{direction:rtl}.dd-row.rev>*{direction:ltr}
  @media (max-width:900px){.dd-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:34px;padding:50px 0}.dd-row.rev{direction:ltr}}
  .dd-eb{font-family:'Inter';font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:13px;display:block}
  .dd-row h3{font-size:clamp(23px,3vw,32px);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:15px}
  .dd-row > div > p{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:15.5px}
  .dlist{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:22px 0 0}
  .dlist li{display:flex;gap:14px;padding:11px 0;font-size:14.5px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-2)}
  .dlist li:first-child{border-top:none}
  .dlist .lbl{font-weight:600;min-width:158px;flex-shrink:0}
  .dlist .val{color:var(--ink-soft)}

  /* signature cards */
  .rep{background:#1a2744;border-radius:16px;padding:26px;color:#fff;box-shadow:var(--sh-lg);font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif}
  .rep-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding-bottom:15px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
  .rep-h .t{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8FA3C0}
  .rep-h .s{font-size:11px;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:100px;font-weight:700;background:rgba(225,87,63,.18);color:#FF9C86}
  .rep-r{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:13px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.09)}
  .rep-r:last-of-type{border-bottom:none}
  .rep-r .k{font-size:13px;color:#C6D3E6}
  .rep-r .v{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:100px;white-space:nowrap}
  .v.ex{background:rgba(225,87,63,.18);color:#FF9C86}
  .v.ok{background:rgba(36,194,125,.16);color:var(--brand-green)}
  .rep-a{margin-top:15px;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(44,95,221,.08);border:1px solid rgba(44,95,221,.22);font-family:'Inter';font-size:13px;color:var(--brand-blue-deep);line-height:1.55}
  .rep-a b{color:#7dd3fc}
  .rep-n{font-size:11.5px;color:#7C8FAB;margin-top:14px;font-family:'Inter'}

  .card-w{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:26px;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
  .ready-h{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end}
  .ready-h .l{font-family:'Inter';font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute)}
  .ready-s{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:700;font-size:34px;color:var(--purple);line-height:1}
  .ready-s span{font-size:15px;color:var(--mute);font-weight:500}
  .bar{height:7px;border-radius:100px;background:var(--paper-2);overflow:hidden;margin:14px 0 18px}
  .bar i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:100px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--purple),var(--teal))}
  .crow{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:12px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line-2)}
  .crow .c{width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:6px;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:1px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
  .c.done{background:#eaf0ff;color:var(--teal-deep)}
  .c.todo{background:#FCEEE9;color:var(--coral)}
  .crow .l2{font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
  .crow .d2{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:2px}
  .card-note{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mute);margin-top:15px}

  .chat{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:22px;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
  .bub{max-width:88%;padding:12px 15px;border-radius:14px;font-size:13.8px;margin-bottom:11px;line-height:1.5}
  .bub.in{background:var(--paper-2);border-bottom-left-radius:4px}
  .bub.out{background:var(--brand-blue);color:#fff;margin-left:auto;border-bottom-right-radius:4px}
  .bub .who{display:block;font-size:10.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:4px;opacity:.65}
  .verdict{margin-top:6px;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:11px;background:#FCEEE9;border:1px solid rgba(225,87,63,.28);font-size:13.5px;color:#8E2E1A;line-height:1.55}
  .verdict b{color:var(--coral)}

  .steps-v{display:grid;gap:0}
  .stepv{display:flex;gap:15px;padding:16px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line-2)}
  .stepv:first-child{border-top:none}
  .stepv .sn{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px;color:#fff;background:var(--brand-blue);width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0}
  .stepv.hl .sn{background:var(--teal-deep)}
  .stepv h4{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:3px}
  .stepv p{font-size:13.4px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0}

  .tcats{display:grid;gap:13px}
  .tcat{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:16px 18px}
  .tcat .cn{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--coral);margin-bottom:8px}
  .tcat .sv{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600}
  .tcat .ds{font-size:13.4px;color:var(--ink-soft)}
  .tcat .sv:not(:first-of-type){margin-top:11px}

  /* SEGMENTS */
  .stabs{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:28px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .stab{padding:10px 20px;border-radius:100px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-soft)}
  .stab[aria-selected="true"]{background:var(--brand-blue);color:#fff;border-color:var(--brand-blue)}
  .spanel{display:none}
  .spanel.active{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:46px;align-items:start}
  @media (max-width:840px){.spanel.active{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:26px}}
  .spanel h3{font-size:clamp(22px,2.8vw,29px);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:14px}
  .spanel > div > p{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:15.5px}
  .spts{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;display:grid;gap:12px}
  .spts li{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:16px 18px}
  .spts strong{display:block;font-size:14.5px;margin-bottom:4px}
  .spts span{font-size:13.4px;color:var(--ink-soft)}

  /* APP */
  .app-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:54px;align-items:center}
  @media (max-width:900px){.app-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:34px}}
  .phone{max-width:288px;margin:0 auto;background:var(--ink);border-radius:32px;padding:10px;box-shadow:var(--sh-lg)}
  .pscr{background:var(--paper);border-radius:24px;padding:17px 13px}
  .ptop{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:15px}
  .ptop .hi{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:600;font-size:14px}
  .ptop .dot{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--ink),var(--teal))}
  .pc{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:11px 13px;margin-bottom:8px}
  .pc .pl{font-size:10px;color:var(--mute);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;font-weight:700}
  .pc .pv{font-size:13.3px;font-weight:600;margin-top:3px}
  .pc .pm{font-size:11.3px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:2px}
  .pcta{background:var(--brand-blue);color:#fff;text-align:center;border-radius:10px;padding:11px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;margin-top:4px}
  .afeats{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:24px 0 0;display:grid;gap:13px}
  .afeats li{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink-soft)}
  .afeats .ic{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:7px;background:#eaf0ff;color:var(--teal-deep);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;margin-top:1px}
  .afeats b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}

  /* TRUST */
  .trust{background:var(--brand-blue-deep);color:#fff}
  .trust h2,.trust .sec-head h2{color:#fff}
  .trust .sec-head p{color:#B9C3D6}
  .g3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}
  @media (max-width:840px){.g3{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
  .tcard{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:var(--r);padding:24px 22px}
  .tcard .ic{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(44,95,221,.16);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:15px}
  .tcard .ic svg{width:19px;height:19px;stroke:#7dd3fc;fill:none;stroke-width:1.8}
  .tcard h4{color:#fff;font-size:16px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px}
  .tcard p{font-size:13.4px;color:#B9C3D6;margin:0}

  /* PRICING */
  .pband{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--paper),var(--paper-2));border-top:1px solid var(--line-2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2)}
  .toggle{display:inline-flex;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:100px;padding:4px;margin:0 auto 36px;gap:2px}
  .toggle button{padding:9px 22px;border-radius:100px;border:none;background:none;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-soft)}
  .toggle button.on{background:var(--brand-blue);color:#fff}
  .toggle .save{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--teal-deep);margin-left:6px}
  .toggle button.on .save{color:#7dd3fc}
  .plans{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin-bottom:44px}
  @media (max-width:940px){.plans{grid-template-columns:1fr;max-width:460px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}}
  .plan{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:28px 24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:relative}
  .plan.best{border:2px solid var(--ink);box-shadow:var(--sh-lg)}
  .plan .flag{position:absolute;top:-12px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--brand-blue);color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:5px 14px;border-radius:100px;white-space:nowrap}
  .plan h4{font-size:19px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:5px}
  .plan .who{font-size:13.2px;color:var(--ink-soft);min-height:38px}
  .plan .amt{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:700;font-size:38px;margin:14px 0 2px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
  .plan .amt small{font-size:15px;font-weight:500;color:var(--mute)}
  .plan .per{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mute);margin-bottom:20px}
  .plan ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0 0 22px;flex:1}
  .plan li{font-size:13.6px;padding:7px 0 7px 24px;position:relative;color:var(--ink-soft)}
  .plan li::before{content:"✓";position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--teal-deep);font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px}
  .plan li.off{color:var(--mute)}
  .plan li.off::before{content:"—";color:#c7ccd6}
  .plan .btn{width:100%;text-align:center}
  .plan-note{text-align:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:-24px;margin-bottom:44px}

  .cmp-wrap{overflow-x:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);background:#fff}
  table.cmp{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;min-width:700px}
  table.cmp th,table.cmp td{padding:15px 18px;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2);font-size:14px}
  table.cmp thead th{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px;background:var(--paper-2)}
  table.cmp thead th.hl{color:var(--teal-deep)}
  table.cmp td.f{color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:500}
  table.cmp td.c,table.cmp th.c{text-align:center}
  table.cmp tbody tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none}
  .yes{color:var(--teal-deep);font-weight:700}
  .no{color:#c7ccd6}
  .ad{font-size:12px;color:var(--purple);font-weight:600}

  /* VALUE */
  .val-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:44px;align-items:center}
  @media (max-width:900px){.val-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:30px}}
  .vrow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:13px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line-2);font-size:14.3px}
  .vrow .vl{color:var(--ink-soft)}
  .vrow .vv{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap}
  .vtot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:16px 0 0;font-weight:700;font-size:16px}
  .vtot .vv{font-family:'Inter';color:var(--coral)}
  .vours{margin-top:18px;padding:18px 20px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--brand-blue-deep);color:#fff;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px}
  .vours .vl{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600}
  .vours .vv{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:700;font-size:24px;color:#7dd3fc}

  /* FAQ */
  .faq{max-width:830px;margin:0 auto}
  .fitem{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .fq{width:100%;background:none;border:none;text-align:left;padding:21px 40px 21px 0;font-family:'Inter';font-size:16.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);position:relative;display:block}
  .fq::after{content:"+";position:absolute;right:6px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font-size:22px;font-weight:400;color:var(--teal-deep)}
  .fitem.open .fq::after{content:"−"}
  .fa{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .28s ease}
  .fitem.open .fa{max-height:460px}
  .fa p{padding:0 30px 21px 0;margin:0;font-size:14.8px;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.65}

  /* EMPLOYERS */
  .pbox{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:40px 36px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:44px;align-items:center;box-shadow:var(--sh-sm)}
  @media (max-width:840px){.pbox{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:26px;padding:30px 24px}}
  .pbox h3{font-size:clamp(22px,2.8vw,28px);margin-bottom:12px}
  .pbox > div > p{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:15px;margin:0 0 18px}
  .pstats{display:flex;gap:26px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .pstats .k{font-family:'Inter';font-weight:600;font-size:19px;color:var(--teal-deep)}
  .pstats .d{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-soft)}
  form.f{display:grid;gap:10px}
  form.f input,form.f select{padding:12px 15px;border-radius:10px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);font-family:'Inter';font-size:14px;background:var(--paper);width:100%}
  form.f input:focus,form.f select:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--teal);background:#fff}
  form.f button{padding:13px;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--brand-blue-deep),var(--brand-blue) 55%,var(--brand-cyan));color:#fff;font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px;border:none;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(44,95,221,.28)}
  form.f button:hover{background:var(--teal-deep)}
  .fmsg{font-size:13px;color:var(--teal-deep);font-weight:500;min-height:16px}

  /* FINAL */
  .final{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--brand-blue-deep),#2c5fdd 55%,var(--brand-cyan) 130%);border-radius:24px;padding:62px 44px;text-align:center;color:#fff;margin:0 28px}
  .final h2{color:#fff;font-size:clamp(26px,4vw,38px);margin-bottom:13px}
  .final p{color:#C9D3E2;font-size:16px;margin-bottom:28px}
  .final .btn-p{background:#fff;color:var(--brand-blue);border-color:#fff;box-shadow:none}
  .final .fine{margin-top:17px;font-size:12.5px;color:#9FB0C7}

  /* FOOTER */
  footer{padding:62px 0 30px}
  .fgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr repeat(4,1fr);gap:30px;padding-bottom:38px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2)}
  @media (max-width:840px){.fgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
  @media (max-width:520px){.fgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
  .fbrand img{height:30px;margin-bottom:13px}
  .fbrand p{font-size:13.4px;color:var(--ink-soft);max-width:265px}
  .fcol h5{font-size:12.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--mute);margin-bottom:13px;font-weight:600}
  .fcol a{display:block;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink-soft);padding:5px 0}
  .fcol a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
  .fbot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;padding-top:24px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mute)}
  .flegal{font-size:12px;color:var(--mute);max-width:700px;line-height:1.6;margin-top:16px}

  .reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px);transition:opacity .6s cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.3,1),transform .6s cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.3,1)}
  .reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
  .g4.reveal.in .wcard, .mods.reveal.in .mcard, .g3.reveal.in .tcard, .plans.reveal.in .plan{
    animation:pop-in .55s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.3,1.1) backwards;
  }
  .g4.reveal.in .wcard:nth-child(1),.mods.reveal.in .mcard:nth-child(1),.g3.reveal.in .tcard:nth-child(1),.plans.reveal.in .plan:nth-child(1){animation-delay:.03s}
  .g4.reveal.in .wcard:nth-child(2),.mods.reveal.in .mcard:nth-child(2),.g3.reveal.in .tcard:nth-child(2),.plans.reveal.in .plan:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.11s}
  .g4.reveal.in .wcard:nth-child(3),.mods.reveal.in .mcard:nth-child(3),.g3.reveal.in .tcard:nth-child(3),.plans.reveal.in .plan:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.19s}
  .g4.reveal.in .wcard:nth-child(4),.mods.reveal.in .mcard:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.27s}
  .mods.reveal.in .mcard:nth-child(5){animation-delay:.35s}
  .mods.reveal.in .mcard:nth-child(6){animation-delay:.43s}
  @keyframes pop-in{ from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(16px) scale(.96);} to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0) scale(1);} }

  /* ---------- SCROLL PROGRESS BAR ---------- */
  .scroll-progress{ position:fixed; top:0; left:0; height:3px; width:0%; z-index:100;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--brand-blue-deep),var(--brand-blue),var(--brand-cyan)); transition:width .08s linear; }

  /* ---------- CURSOR SPOTLIGHT (hero) ---------- */
  .hero{ position:relative; }
  .hero::before{
    content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:0;
    background:radial-gradient(480px circle at var(--mx,50%) var(--my,20%), rgba(44,95,221,.10), transparent 60%);
    transition:background .05s linear;
  }
  .hero .wrap{ position:relative; z-index:1; }

  /* ---------- TILT / MAGNETIC CARDS ---------- */
  .tilt{ transform-style:preserve-3d; will-change:transform; transition:transform .12s ease-out, box-shadow .25s ease; }
  .mcard.tilt:hover, .wcard.tilt:hover, .tcard.tilt:hover, .plan.tilt:hover{ box-shadow:var(--sh-lg); }
  .tilt-glow{
    position:absolute; inset:0; border-radius:inherit; opacity:0; pointer-events:none;
    background:radial-gradient(220px circle at var(--gx,50%) var(--gy,50%), rgba(44,95,221,.14), transparent 65%);
    transition:opacity .25s ease; z-index:0;
  }
  .tilt:hover .tilt-glow{ opacity:1; }
  .mcard, .wcard, .tcard{ position:relative; overflow:hidden; }
  .plan{ position:relative; overflow:visible; }
  .mcard > *:not(.tilt-glow), .wcard > *:not(.tilt-glow), .tcard > *:not(.tilt-glow), .plan > *:not(.tilt-glow):not(.flag){ position:relative; z-index:1; }
  .plan .flag{ z-index:2; }

  /* ---------- MAGNETIC BUTTONS ---------- */
  .btn{ position:relative; will-change:transform; }

  /* ---------- ORBIT INTERACTIVITY ---------- */
  .ring{ animation:spin-slow 90s linear infinite; }
  .ring.r2{ animation:spin-slow-rev 70s linear infinite; }
  @keyframes spin-slow{ from{transform:rotate(0deg);} to{transform:rotate(360deg);} }
  @keyframes spin-slow-rev{ from{transform:rotate(0deg);} to{transform:rotate(-360deg);} }
  .onode{ cursor:pointer; transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), box-shadow .25s ease, border-color .25s ease; }
  .onode:hover{ transform:scale(1.22) !important; box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(44,95,221,.22); border-color:var(--teal); z-index:5; }
  .onode:active{ transform:scale(1.05) !important; }
  .core{ animation:core-pulse 3.2s ease-in-out infinite; cursor:pointer; }
  @keyframes core-pulse{ 0%,100%{ box-shadow:0 20px 46px rgba(44,95,221,.28), 0 0 0 0 rgba(0,176,214,.35);} 50%{ box-shadow:0 20px 46px rgba(44,95,221,.28), 0 0 0 14px rgba(0,176,214,0);} }
  .olabel{ transition:opacity .2s ease, transform .2s ease; }
  .onode:hover ~ .olabel, .olabel:hover{ opacity:1; }

  /* ---------- STAT COUNT-UP ---------- */
  .stripe .it{ transition:transform .3s ease; }
  .stripe.counted .it{ animation:stat-pop .5s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.3,1.2) backwards; }
  .stripe .it:nth-child(1){ animation-delay:.05s } .stripe .it:nth-child(2){ animation-delay:.15s }
  .stripe .it:nth-child(3){ animation-delay:.25s } .stripe .it:nth-child(4){ animation-delay:.35s }
  @keyframes stat-pop{ from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(10px) scale(.9);} to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0) scale(1);} }

  /* ---------- NAV SHRINK ON SCROLL ---------- */
  header{ transition:box-shadow .25s ease, background .25s ease; }
  header.scrolled{ box-shadow:0 2px 18px rgba(44,95,221,.08); }
  header.scrolled .navbar{ padding-top:9px; padding-bottom:9px; }
  .navbar{ transition:padding .2s ease; }

  /* ---------- MODULE ICON MICRO-INTERACTION ---------- */
  .mic{ transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), box-shadow .25s ease; }
  .mcard:hover .mic{ transform:rotate(-8deg) scale(1.1); }
  .mcard{ transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.3,1.1), box-shadow .25s ease, border-color .25s ease; }
  .mcard:hover{ border-color:rgba(0,176,214,.35); }
  .mcard li{ transition:transform .18s ease, color .18s ease; }
  .mcard:hover li{ color:var(--ink); }

  /* ---------- FAQ ICON ROTATE ---------- */
  .fq::after{ transition:transform .28s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), color .2s ease; display:inline-block; }
  .fitem.open .fq::after{ content:"+"; transform:translateY(-50%) rotate(45deg); color:var(--coral); }
  .fq{ transition:color .2s ease; }
  .fq:hover{ color:var(--teal-deep); }

  /* ---------- COMPARISON TABLE ROW HOVER ---------- */
  table.cmp tbody tr{ transition:background .15s ease; }
  table.cmp tbody tr:hover{ background:#f2f5fb; }
  table.cmp tbody tr:hover td.f{ color:var(--ink); font-weight:600; }

  /* ---------- PLAN "MOST CHOSEN" SHINE ---------- */
  .plan.best{ position:relative; }
  .plan.best::after{
    content:""; position:absolute; top:0; left:-60%; width:40%; height:100%;
    background:linear-gradient(100deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,.5), transparent);
    transform:skewX(-20deg); animation:shine 4.5s ease-in-out infinite; pointer-events:none;
  }
  @keyframes shine{ 0%,20%{ left:-60%; } 45%,100%{ left:130%; } }

  /* ---------- WHY CARD ICON NUMBER FLOURISH ---------- */
  .wcard{ transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.3,1.1), box-shadow .25s ease, border-color .25s ease; }
  .wcard:hover{ border-color:rgba(0,176,214,.35); }
  .wcard .n{ transition:transform .25s ease, color .25s ease; display:inline-block; }
  .wcard:hover .n{ transform:scale(1.15) translateY(-2px); color:var(--teal); }

  /* ---------- SIGNATURE CARD HOVER LIFT ---------- */
  .rep, .card-w, .chat{ transition:transform .3s ease, box-shadow .3s ease; }
  .rep:hover, .card-w:hover, .chat:hover{ transform:translateY(-4px); box-shadow:0 28px 60px rgba(44,95,221,.16); }

  /* ---------- LIVE ACTIVITY TICKER ---------- */
  .ticker-band{ background:var(--brand-blue-deep); overflow:hidden; padding:14px 0; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); }
  .ticker-track{ display:flex; gap:0; width:max-content; animation:ticker-scroll 32s linear infinite; }
  .ticker-band:hover .ticker-track{ animation-play-state:paused; }
  .ticker-item{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:0 34px; font-size:13px; color:#C6D3E6; white-space:nowrap; border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); }
  .ticker-item .dot{ width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--teal); flex-shrink:0; }
  .ticker-item b{ color:#fff; font-weight:600; }
  @keyframes ticker-scroll{ from{ transform:translateX(0); } to{ transform:translateX(-50%); } }

  /* ---------- EXPOSURE QUIZ (interactive) ---------- */
  .quiz-band{ background:linear-gradient(155deg,var(--brand-blue-deep) 0%, #2c5fdd 55%, var(--brand-cyan) 140%); position:relative; overflow:hidden; }
  .quiz-band::before{
    content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; opacity:.5; pointer-events:none;
    background:radial-gradient(600px circle at 15% 20%, rgba(44,95,221,.18), transparent 55%),
               radial-gradient(500px circle at 85% 80%, rgba(108,74,158,.22), transparent 55%);
  }
  .quiz-wrap{ position:relative; z-index:1; display:grid; grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr; gap:50px; align-items:center; }
  @media (max-width:900px){ .quiz-wrap{ grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:32px; } }
  .quiz-wrap h2{ color:#fff; font-size:clamp(26px,3.4vw,36px); margin-bottom:14px; }
  .quiz-wrap .qsub{ color:#C9D3E2; font-size:15.5px; margin-bottom:0; }
  .quiz-card{ background:#fff; border-radius:20px; padding:32px; box-shadow:var(--sh-lg); min-height:340px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
  .quiz-progress{ display:flex; gap:6px; margin-bottom:22px; }
  .quiz-progress i{ flex:1; height:4px; border-radius:100px; background:var(--paper-2); }
  .quiz-progress i.done{ background:var(--teal); }
  .quiz-step{ display:none; flex:1; flex-direction:column; }
  .quiz-step.active{ display:flex; animation:qstep-in .35s ease; }
  @keyframes qstep-in{ from{opacity:0; transform:translateX(14px);} to{opacity:1; transform:translateX(0);} }
  .quiz-step h3{ font-size:19px; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:18px; }
  .quiz-opts{ display:grid; gap:10px; }
  .quiz-opt{ text-align:left; padding:14px 18px; border-radius:12px; border:1.5px solid var(--line); background:var(--paper); font-size:14.5px; font-weight:500; color:var(--ink); transition:border-color .15s ease, background .15s ease, transform .15s ease; }
  .quiz-opt:hover{ border-color:var(--brand-blue); background:#eaf0ff; transform:translateX(3px); }
  .quiz-opt.picked{ border-color:var(--brand-blue); background:#eaf0ff; font-weight:600; }
  .quiz-result{ display:none; flex:1; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; text-align:center; animation:qstep-in .4s ease; }
  .quiz-result.active{ display:flex; }
  .quiz-score{ font-family:'Inter'; font-weight:700; font-size:52px; margin-bottom:6px; background:linear-gradient(100deg,var(--coral),var(--purple)); -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent; }
  .quiz-score-label{ font-size:13px; color:var(--mute); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:18px; }
  .quiz-result p{ color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:14.5px; margin-bottom:22px; }
  .quiz-restart{ font-size:13px; color:var(--teal-deep); font-weight:600; margin-top:14px; align-self:center; }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
    .ring, .ring.r2, .core, .plan.best::after, .ticker-track{ animation:none !important; }
  }

</style>
<style>
  .scroll-progress{display:none}
  main{padding:0}
  .subhero{padding:64px 0 24px}
  .subhero .lead{max-width:640px;font-size:17px;line-height:1.55;margin-top:14px}
  .subhero .eyebrow{margin-bottom:16px}
  .subhero h1{font-size:clamp(32px,4.6vw,50px);font-weight:600;max-width:760px}
</style>
</head>
<body>

    <a href="index.html" class="brand"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="SurakshaOne"><span class="brand-name">Suraksha<b>One</b></span></a>
    <nav class="nav-links" id="navLinks">

          <a href="#d-cyber"><i style="background:var(--blue)"></i><span>CyberSafe<em>Identity exposure &amp; scam checks</em></span></a>
          <a href="#d-travel"><i style="background:var(--coral)"></i><span>TravelShield<em>Assistance anywhere you go</em></span></a>
          <a href="#d-life"><i style="background:var(--brand-blue-deep)"></i><span>LifeSecure<em>Money, documents &amp; nominees</em></span></a>

    </div>

</header>
<main id="top">

<section id="modules">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head center reveal">
      <span class="eyebrow">What's covered</span>
      <h2>Five protections, one membership</h2>
      <p>Every plan includes all five. You don't pick and choose — the point is that the gaps are closed.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="mods reveal">

      <div class="mcard">
        <div class="mic i-well"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"><circle cx="12" cy="7" r="3.2"/><path d="M5 20c0-3.5 3-6 7-6s7 2.5 7 6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></div>
        <h3>Wellness</h3><p class="tag">A doctor before you need a hospital</p>
        <ul><li>Unlimited GP tele-consultation</li><li>Dietician consultation &amp; personal diet chart</li><li>Up to 30% off diagnostic tests</li><li>Up to 30% off dental care</li><li>Up to 15% off vision &amp; eyewear</li><li>Discounted medicine delivery</li><li>Mental health consultations</li></ul>
        <div class="mfoot"><a href="#d-well">How it works →</a></div>
      </div>

      <div class="mcard">
        <div class="mic i-cyber"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"><rect x="5.5" y="10.5" width="13" height="9" rx="2"/><path d="M8.5 10.5V7.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 7 0v3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></div>

  <div class="wrap">

    <div class="dd-row reveal" id="d-cyber">
      <div>
        <span class="dd-eb">CyberSafe · identity exposure</span>
        <h3>Scamsters don't guess your data. They already have it.</h3>
        <p>A fraud call works because the caller already knows your real address or PAN number — details that were supposed to be private. Everything they say afterwards inherits the credibility of the part that was true. CyberSafe shows you what of yours is already circulating, and exactly what to do about each item.</p>
        <ul class="dlist">
          <li><span class="lbl">On joining</span><span class="val">A full exposure report across your identity documents</span></li>
          <li><span class="lbl">Ongoing</span><span class="val">Alerts when your details surface in a new breach</span></li>
          <li><span class="lbl">Any time</span><span class="val">Forward a suspicious message and get a verdict</span></li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="rep">
        <div class="rep-h"><span class="t">Identity exposure report</span><span class="s">4 exposures</span>
        </div>
        <div class="rep-r"><span class="k">PAN number</span><span class="v ex">Exposed</span></div>
        <div class="rep-r"><span class="k">Registered address</span><span class="v ex">Exposed</span></div>
        <div class="rep-r"><span class="k">Email password</span><span class="v ex">Exposed</span></div>
        <div class="rep-r"><span class="k">Mobile number</span><span class="v ex">Exposed</span></div>
        <div class="rep-r"><span class="k">Aadhaar number</span><span class="v ok">No match</span></div>
        <div class="rep-r"><span class="k">Passport number</span><span class="v ok">No match</span></div>
        <div class="rep-a"><b>Do this now →</b> Your PAN is exposed. Pull your credit report this week and look for loans you didn't take. Catching a fraudulent loan early is the difference between a phone call and a five-year credit problem.</div>
        <p class="rep-n">Illustrative sample. Your report shows only your own data.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="dd-row rev reveal" id="d-scam">
      <div>
        <span class="dd-eb">CyberSafe · the check line</span>
        <h3>Forward it. We'll tell you if it's real.</h3>
        <p>The single most useful thing we can give someone is a place to ask "is this legitimate?" before they act — not a fraud helpline afterwards. Send us the message, the caller's number or the link, and get a plain answer back.</p>
        <div class="steps-v" style="margin-top:20px">
          <div class="stepv"><span class="sn">1</span><div><h4>Something feels off</h4><p>A message about a refund, a KYC deadline, a courier, a job offer.</p></div></div>
          <div class="stepv"><span class="sn">2</span><div><h4>You forward it to us</h4><p>Screenshot, link or number — whatever you have.</p></div></div>
          <div class="stepv hl"><span class="sn">3</span><div><h4>You get a verdict, not a lecture</h4><p>What it is, what it's trying to get, and what to do next.</p></div></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="chat">
        <div class="bub in"><span class="who">Forwarded message</span>Your electricity connection will be disconnected tonight at 9:30. Update your meter details immediately on this link or call 98XXXXXX21.</div>
        <div class="bub out"><span class="who">SurakshaOne</span>This is a known scam pattern. Electricity boards never send disconnection notices by SMS with a payment link, and they don't use personal mobile numbers.</div>
        <div class="verdict"><b>Verdict: scam.</b> Don't call the number or open the link. If you already did, tell us now — the next steps depend on what you shared and how long ago.</div>
      </div>
    </div>

        <h3>Senior citizens lost ₹4,005 crore to fraud last year.</h3>
        <p>They're the most targeted group in the country and the least likely to call you about it — because they're embarrassed, or they don't want to worry you. ParentCare gives your parents their own line for medical help and scam checks, in their language, and tells you when something happens.</p>
        <ul class="dlist">
          <li><span class="lbl">For them</span><span class="val">A number they can call for a doctor or a scam check</span></li>
          <li><span class="lbl">In their language</span><span class="val">Support in the language they're comfortable speaking</span></li>
          <li><span class="lbl">For you</span><span class="val">A notification when they use it, so you're not the last to know</span></li>
          <li><span class="lbl">On the ground</span><span class="val">Medicine delivery, test bookings and appointment coordination</span></li>

Wellness gives you a GP for the small things you'd otherwise ignore, a dietician who builds an actual diet chart around what your kitchen cooks, and standing discounts across diagnostics, dental, vision and medicines. Preventive care you use, rather than intend to.</p>

<script>
  function q(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }
  var navToggle=q('navToggle'), navLinks=q('navLinks'), ddProt=q('ddProt');
  if (navToggle && navLinks){
    navToggle.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var o = navLinks.classList.toggle('open');
      navToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', o);
    });
    navLinks.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function(a){
      a.addEventListener('click', function(){
        if (ddProt && a.parentElement === ddProt && window.innerWidth <= 960) return;
        navLinks.classList.remove('open');
        navToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
        if (ddProt) ddProt.classList.remove('open');
      });
    });
  }
  if (ddProt){
    var ddLink = ddProt.querySelector('a');
    if (ddLink) ddLink.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      if (window.innerWidth <= 960){ e.preventDefault(); ddProt.classList.toggle('open'); }
    });
  }

  var headerEl = document.querySelector('header');
  if (headerEl){
    function updateHeader(){ headerEl.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 12); }
    document.addEventListener('scroll', updateHeader, {passive:true});
    updateHeader();
  }

  var rev = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
  if (rev.length){
    if ('IntersectionObserver' in window){
      var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(es){ es.forEach(function(en){ if(en.isIntersecting){ en.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(en.target); } }); }, {threshold:.1, rootMargin:'0px 0px -40px 0px'});
      rev.forEach(function(el){ io.observe(el); });
    } else rev.forEach(function(el){ el.classList.add('in'); });
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('.fq').forEach(function(qel){
    qel.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var item = qel.parentElement, was = item.classList.contains('open');
      document.querySelectorAll('.fitem').forEach(function(i){ i.classList.remove('open'); });
      if (!was) item.classList.add('open');
    });
  });

  var pForm = q('pForm'), pMsg = q('pMsg');
  if (pForm && pMsg){
    pForm.addEventListener('submit', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      pMsg.textContent = "Thanks — we'll be in touch within two working days.";
      pForm.reset();
    });
  }
</script>
